thread:
Rohit: ran the chunked/streaming attention bench across A100/H100/L40S with the new eviction heuristic. results are weird, need eyes. seq sweep 32/64/128/256/512, batch 1/4/8. posting high-level numbers + notes.

Chen: drop the top-line numbers pls (latency p50/p95, throughput tok/s, and any kv spill counts).

Rohit: ok pasted quick table: 
```
Model variant: fused-stream-chunked
HW: A100 / H100 / L40S
Seq	Batch	A100 p50(ms)	A100 p95(ms)	A100 tok/s	A100 spills	H100 p95(ms)	L40S p95(ms)
32	1	18	32	2100	0	20	45
64	1	28	55	1800	0	33	80
128	1	55	110	1400	2	80	160
256	1	120	240	800	6	170	360
512	1	320	680	300	18	420	920

Batch4 made p95 ~ divide-latency-ish for short seqs but spikes on 256+/kv spills.
```

Eve: looking at KV metrics, spills line up with seq>=128 and batch>=4. eviction threshold of 1.2x cache size is causing premature spill under our continuous-batch window. also saw lots of small allreduce stalls on H100 for the fused kernel when seq>256.

Chen: thanks. a couple thoughts: (1) the fused-stream-chunked kernel still uses the legacy KV layout for now — that increases alloc churn for high-batch streaming. (2) try a softened eviction policy: keep soft_limit = 0.9 * cache_capacity for streaming sessions with batch>1 and seq>128. (3) add a quick path to bypass KV consolidation when batch==1 (avoids copying).

Ben: we should also compare against paged-attn variant on the same runs — last time paged did better at seq=512 on L40S. can we push a single run with paged + same eviction config?

Rohit: launching paged-attn run now (A100/H100/L40S) with soft_limit=0.9 and batch bypass. will post perf-bot link.

perf-bot: automated report for thread 1766789012: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1766789012. includes flamegraphs, nvprof traces (A100/H100/L40S), and kv-metrics. brief summary: fused-stream wins up to seq=128; paged takes lead at 256+ on L40S; H100 shows instability ~seq512 for fused-stream with many small kernels (see kernel-sched spikes).

Eve: flagged an action: adjust eviction soft_limit for streaming sessions and add condition to kernel selector to prefer paged-attn when (seq>=256 && hw==L40S). open PR or do a quick runtime toggle?

Chen: put runtime toggle first (hotfix) + perf regression test. we need CI benchmarks for seq 128/256/512 with batch 1/4 across devices.

Ben: agreed. also capture memory allocation traces — the fused-stream path still has a memcpy in prepare_kv for batch>1 that kills latency tail.

Rohit: noted. i'll push runtime toggle and kick CI. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Eve: adding to followup: investigate H100 kernel scheduling to reduce micro-kernel launch overheads (maybe merge small kernels) — filing ticket. :spiral_calendar:

Chen: tagging @perf-bot to run nightly sweep with the new eviction config and produce diffs.

Rohit: closing loop — will update with CI pass and a short summary in eng-runtime channel once we have paged vs fused diff artifacts.
